title: Why you are a little taller in the morning
examples: Am I taller in the morning?
Why do we shrink during the day?
Why do astronauts get taller in space?

forces.label: Body weight
forces.ask: Why do we shrink during the day?

explain.say: If you measure your height first thing in the morning and again at bedtime, you will usually find you have shrunk by about a centimetre during the day.

draw.text: Why you are a little taller in the morning

forces.label: Body weight
forces.ask: Why do we shrink during the day?

explain.say: Between the bones of your spine are soft, springy discs, like water-filled cushions. All day, standing and sitting, the weight of your body presses down on them.

forces.label: Body weight
forces.ask: Why do we shrink during the day?

explain.say: The discs push back, but they slowly lose a little water and get slightly thinner. With over 20 discs each squashing a tiny bit, your spine gets shorter.

forces.label: Body weight
forces.ask: Why do we shrink during the day?

explain.say: At night, lying down takes the weight off. The discs soak up water and swell back, so you wake up at your tallest.

marks.label: Morning: back up
marks.ask: Why am I taller in the morning?

faq.a: Spinal discs are tough, springy pads between the bones of the spine. Each has a soft, watery centre inside a ring of fibres, acting as a shock absorber and letting the spine bend.
asks: What is between the bones of the spine?

faq.q: Why do we shrink during the day?
faq.a: When you are upright, your body weight squashes the discs in your spine and they slowly lose a little water. Each gets slightly thinner, so your spine and height shrink by about a centimetre.
asks: How much shorter do we get by evening?

faq.q: Why am I taller in the morning?
faq.a: Lying down at night takes the weight off your spine, so the discs soak up fluid and swell back to full thickness. You wake up at your tallest.
asks: Why do I get taller when I sleep?

faq.q: Why do astronauts get taller in space?
faq.a: In orbit there is almost no squashing from body weight, so the spinal discs expand. Astronauts can grow up to about 3 percent taller, a few centimetres, and shrink back on returning to Earth.
asks: How much taller do astronauts get?

faq.q: Is this the same as growing?
faq.a: No. Real growth happens at the growth plates in bones and is permanent. The daily change is just the discs squashing and swelling, and it happens to adults too.
asks: Do adults change height during the day?

facts: People are typically about 1 centimetre taller in the morning than in the evening.
The human spine has 23 intervertebral discs.
Astronauts can become up to about 3 percent taller during long stays in space.

wrong.1: Bones do not grow and shrink each day; the change is in the discs.
wrong.2: Muscles relax in sleep, but the height change comes from the discs.
